report.speaker: David Witt Nyström
report.title: Two Calabi–Yau Theorems for Degenerations of Compact Kähler Manifolds
report.copyright: 2026 International Mathematical Union; published by SIAM
report.question: 固定紧 Kähler 类的退化能否实现任意分支体积分配，以及这种有限维存在性如何连接到非阿基米德有限能量 Monge–Ampère 同胚？
report.reading_scope: Read all mathematical sections 1–7 and bibliography of arXiv:2510.03044v1, PDF pp.1–19, not merely the abstract; compared SIAM official HTML sections 1–7, exact Theorems A/B, theorem-number changes, and licensing metadata. Also read arXiv:2509.09442v1 introduction sections 1.1–1.5, section 4.1–4.2, section 6 including its proofs, and sections 8.2–8.3. The latter paper was not read in full. Only primary sources are used.

proof_scope.2N01: Definition of real (1,1) classes and smooth potentials; dd^c lemma cited, not proved. Normalization dd^c=i/pi partial barpartial matches existing 0K13.
proof_scope.2N02: Direct proof by the difference-of-powers identity and Stokes; total volume uses omega^n, not omega^n/n!.
proof_scope.2N03: Direct integration-by-parts proof, including the sign and positivity of du wedge d^c u; connectedness and supremum normalization retained.
proof_scope.2N04: Precise smooth positive-volume theorem; existence attributed to Yau, uniqueness linked to 2N03.
proof_scope.2N05: Current, test topology and strong positivity defined; integration-current example. General singular psh definition separated into 2N0Y.
proof_scope.2N06: Big class definition and elementary equivalence with Kahler plus pseudoeffective; convexity proved using currents. Closedness/interior facts cited.
proof_scope.2N07: Envelope minimal-singularity comparison proved after citing the psh upper-envelope theorem; boundedness characterization in a Kahler class derived.
proof_scope.2N08: Lelong numbers defined locally and for classes; logarithmic example calculated. No regularization theorem proved.
proof_scope.2N09: Non-pluripolar truncation construction explained; Bedford–Taylor products, local finiteness, gluing and independence for minimal singularities are external analytic inputs.
proof_scope.2N0A: Restricted volume definition with all three locus cases; restriction bound quoted from report section 5.8; no full restricted-volume theory claimed.
proof_scope.2N0B: Divisorial derivative and linear-relations corollary stated as separate cited analytic results, not a formal deduction of linearity from directional derivatives. Kahler polynomial special case calculated.
proof_scope.2N0C: Smooth compact SNC dominating model with lifted C* action, vertical real divisors, and A=pi_X^*alpha defined; general Kahler construction not replaced by Fano algebraic 0BF7.
proof_scope.2N0D: Model mass formula and total mass one proved by homologous fibres; all multiplicities b_i retained.
proof_scope.2N0E: Product model binomial calculation: F^2=0, A^(n+1)=0, (A+cF)^(n+1)=(n+1)cV, fixed Dirac measure.
proof_scope.2N0F: Big test-configuration measure defined through restricted volumes; mass-one property is a consequence link, not a prerequisite of the definition.
proof_scope.2N0G: Theorem 3.4 and Proposition 6.1 cited with proof outline. Corrected negative-perturbation mass algebra is explicit; continuity, good perturbations and restriction estimates remain analytic inputs.
proof_scope.2N0H: Self-contained finite-dimensional surjectivity argument: Sperner parity by induction, shrinking barycentric subdivisions, compact subsequence limit, coordinate-sum equality, boundary approximation. N=1 handled separately. No use of a radial retraction at a possibly boundary missing point.
proof_scope.2N0I: Theorem A with all fixed-model hypotheses. Finite-dimensional deduction proved from analytic mass/continuity and geometric divisor construction: convexity of actual restricted classes, face preservation, then 2N0H. Does not claim uniqueness of D.
proof_scope.2N0J: Analytic coherent ideal sheaf definition given locally, not substituted by algebraic Noether scheme page; Oka coherence cited for operations.
proof_scope.2N0K: Tropical analytification and semivaluation operations defined; compact Hausdorff theorem cited.
proof_scope.2N0L: Local ideal vanishing-order calculation proves semivaluation identities and explains division by b_i; density of divisorial points cited.
proof_scope.2N0M: Normalized skeleton simplex uses sum b_i w_i=1. Monomial normalization and two-weight endpoint examples calculated; no inverse-limit theorem reconstructed.
proof_scope.2N0N: PL function via divisor coefficients on dominating models; continuous extension and model independence cited. Central fibre gives the constant one.
proof_scope.2N0O: Relative Kahler model potentials and decreasing-net psh limits defined. Nets used because analytification need not be metrizable.
proof_scope.2N0P: Finite energy potentials and the precise strong topology defined; quotient normalization is supremum zero.
proof_scope.2N0Q: Dual energy and strong measure topology defined; weak convergence alone is not asserted sufficient.
proof_scope.2N0R: Model MA measure defined and probability property reduced to 2N0D after central-fibre translation; extension to E1 and continuity cited.
proof_scope.2N0S: Model first derivative explicitly expanded and identified with integral against MA, retaining b_i cancellation. Constant shift energy and MA invariance proved for models and transported via definitions/extension.
proof_scope.2N0T: Theorem B precisely stated as a homeomorphism in two strong topologies. Algebraic Boucksom–Jonsson result distinguished from general Kahler Mesquita-Piccione–Witt Nystrom extension. Section 6 summarized as a proof outline, not a complete analytic proof.
proof_scope.2N0U: Envelope definition plus directly proved 1-Lipschitz stability; continuity and psh property are explicitly external Theorem 1.4.1.
proof_scope.2N0V: Orthogonality deduction fully written conditional on model envelope MA formula, one-sided Lelong estimate, PL uniform density and uniform-potential MA continuity. Uniform/weak integral passage estimated explicitly. Does not claim to prove the two-sided equality in report Proposition 7.4.
proof_scope.2N0W: Divisorial-measure solution derived from A and the model envelope formula; normalized uniqueness cited from B, no uniqueness of divisor claimed.
proof_scope.2N0X: Graph-distance polynomial and sign of restrictions derived. Connectedness of modification fibres and bigness of pullback of a Kahler class are cited geometric inputs. Actual finite-t classes, not limiting gamma vectors, used for convexity.
proof_scope.2N0Y: Psh and theta-psh functions defined separately from currents, including upper semicontinuity, local potentials and canonical representative; basic local integrability/positive-current characterization cited.
proof_scope.2N0Z: Pseudoeffective classes separated from big classes; positive-current convexity explained, closedness cited.
proof_scope.2N10: Analytic singularity definition with bounded remainder as in the report, and a local logarithmic example.
proof_scope.2N11: Non-Kahler/non-nef loci and good hypersurface convention separated from Lelong numbers; elementary locus inclusion proved.

remaining_branches: Yau existence estimates and complete classical finite-energy pluripotential theory remain cited inputs.
Bedford–Taylor/BEGZ non-pluripolar product construction, regularization, restricted-volume approximation, and full proof of divisorial volume differentiability are not reconstructed.
Report Theorem 3.4/Proposition 6.1 good-perturbation and continuity arguments are outlined, with corrected displayed algebra, not promoted to self-contained proofs.
Tropical analytification compactness, inverse-limit theorem, model independence and density are external constructions; no independent proof of the whole non-Archimedean theory.
Envelope continuity, model-envelope measure identity, Lelong regularization bound, finite-energy compactness and strong metric estimates remain external inputs.
Full cscK/YTD applications, valuative beta-invariant, general nontrivially valued fields, and conjectural full transcendental cone duality are outside this packet.
The arXiv v1 blow-up obstruction example has inconsistent ambient dimension notation; it is not imported. The elementary zero-mass obstruction is used instead.
Root registration, whole-site build, rendered/browser QA and independent final acceptance are assigned to parent.

source_errata: arXiv:2510.03044v1 section 4.3 prints sum b_i w_i <= 1. SIAM section 4.3 uses =1, consistent with v(tau)=1 and the simplex vertices. New 2N0M uses equality. MW25 v1 introduction also has the <= typo.
Report Proposition 6.1 has (1-epsilon)^n V despite B_epsilon=(A+D)+epsilon(A+D'). Generic-fibre class is (1+epsilon)alpha. New 2N0G uses (1+epsilon)^n V for sufficiently small negative epsilon.
Same display loses b_j weights. Correct right side is sum_{j!=i} b_j g_j(D)=V-b_i g_i(D), not V-g_i(D). All new formulas retain multiplicities.
Lemma 6.2 conclusion displays restriction to E_j while indexing H_k. New 2N0X consistently restricts to E_k.

Theorem A proof asserts equality of actual restricted classes with -sum a_i gamma_{j,i}; lemma gives only large-t halfspace membership after a rescaled limit. New 2N0I uses convex combinations of actual restrictions, not that equality.

Theorem A proof invokes radial retraction for a possibly boundary missing point. New 2N0H handles N=1 separately, proves interior coverage by Sperner and covers boundary by compactness and density, without that issue.

Report Proposition 7.4 and MW25 v1 Proposition 4.2.3 print nu(T)<=nu(class)-epsilon, impossible when nu(class) is the infimum. Approximation must have +epsilon, and the final chain must retain b_i^{-1}. New 2N0V cites the correct one-sided bound only and does not reproduce the faulty regularization proof.
Report Theorem 7.3 point-mass lower-bound display omits b_i, while the theorem formula retains it. New model-envelope formula includes b_i throughout.
SIAM section 7 briefly writes X_0=sum E_i despite retaining b_i later. New statements consistently use sum b_i E_i without an unannounced reduced-fibre assumption.
Report section 5.9 formula (5.2) has alpha^n dot beta in the correction term; dimension requires n alpha^(n-1) dot beta. This conjectural branch is not imported.

Report section 5.8 modification formula prints mu^*beta-beta where the second class should be beta' on the modification. New definition uses minimal currents and perturbation rather than copying that display.
arXiv v1 section 3.2 blow-up example has inconsistent X and total-space notation; SIAM omits its details. New packet uses the proved zero-mass obstruction and trivial-model example instead.
Report section 7 final orthogonality proof writes D_epsilon in a vanishing expression without defining epsilon there. New proof uses B=A+D consistently.
Formal Theorem 5.2/Corollary 5.3 numbering differs from arXiv v1 Theorem 5.1/Corollary 5.2; reference and metadata preserve the distinction.

not_substituted.0BF7: Fano algebraic test configurations do not define general transcendental Kahler test configurations.
not_substituted.0K13: Continuous-potential positive currents reused only as a special case; general currents and singular psh separated into 2N05/2N0Y.
not_substituted.01B4: Noether scheme coherent sheaves do not replace analytic coherent ideals; 2N0J supplies the precise local analytic notion.
not_substituted.0BF2: Algebraic Weil/Cartier divisor definition is not used as a substitute for analytic divisors on nonprojective manifolds.
